name: Aggregation JS CSS async defer
description: Adds async/defer attributes to any JS/CSS asset library site-wide and splits aggregates so each combined file carries a single attribute.
project_description: This module lets you attach the async or defer attribute to any Drupal asset library's JS and CSS, either per library or forced across all JS/CSS, without editing core or contrib libraries.yml. It works by swapping core's asset resolver and the CSS/JS collection groupers (via a ServiceProvider, no hooks), so that at asset-build time it injects the chosen attribute into each matching library's assets and rewrites aggregation grouping to emit a separate combined file per attribute (a deferred bundle and an async bundle instead of one mixed file). Configuration lives at Configuration > Development > Performance, where two 'Force all JS / CSS' radios and per-library None/Async/Defer radios (for every core, module, default-theme and base-theme library) are stored in the agg_jscss_asyncdefer.settings config object.
